questions.stem: What makes active transport different from diffusion and osmosis?

options.text: Active transport only moves water molecules
Active transport moves substances from low concentration to high concentration, using energy
Active transport moves substances from high concentration to low concentration
Active transport only occurs in plant cells

questions.explanation: Active transport moves substances against their concentration gradient, from an area of lower concentration to an area of higher concentration. This requires energy from cellular respiration (ATP), unlike diffusion and osmosis which are passive processes.
